messages:
Priya: :mega: FYI team — planned master rotation + autoscaler smoke in eu-west-1. Window: 2025-11-12 02:00 -> 03:30 UTC. Purpose: apply control-plane patch + validate HPA scaling velocity. Expect control-plane API spikes and transient 5xx for management endpoints for ~5-12m per master restart.
Omar: Will this impact inference traffic or auth/token ops?
Priya: Inference (data plane) and token generation kept on separate nodes; we don't expect customer traffic drops. Management APIs (deploys, scale) may see timeouts.
Nina: Infra will rotate masters one at a time, wait for leader election and metrics stabilization between restarts. We'll run `kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system` and leader-election logs check.
Carlos: After rotation we run autoscaler smoke: apply `hpa-stress.yaml` and expect scale within 90s. I9ll own the smoke.
Priya: New temporary alerting rule for this window: PD suppression + SLO-burn allowance of +25% for 90m (02:00-03:30). Non-management user-facing SLOs remain normal.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: control-plane-patch v2.15 -> 2025-11-12T02:10:00Z (initiated by infra).
pagerduty-bot: PD suppression active for policy "control-plane-maintenance-eu-west" 2025-11-12T02:00:00Z -> 2025-11-12T03:30:00Z.
Omar: Please paste the quick runbook here so oncall has it pinned.
Priya: Runbook snippet (short):
```
1) T-30m: run preflight (etcd health, recent backups, no active cluster upgrade)
2) For each master in eu-west-masters (sequential):
   - ssh infra@<master> -- sudo systemctl restart kube-apiserver
   - wait 180s, validate `/metrics` and leader-election log entries
   - if apiserver 5xx > 8% for 4m -> rollback: `sudo systemctl start kube-apiserver@previous` and abort further restarts
3) After all masters: run autoscaler smoke (Carlos) and revert stress manifest
4) Post-maint: collect apiserver metrics snapshot and upload to /ops/maintenance/1853012345
```
Nina: I'll trigger a backup at T-2h and post a confirmation. Also will open ephemeral incident channel `#incidents/maint-eu-west-2025-11-12`.
Carlos: Autoscaler test steps: `kubectl apply -f hpa-stress.yaml` -> watch `kubectl get hpa -w` -> expect replica increase within 90s -> `kubectl delete -f hpa-stress.yaml` to revert. I'll run smoke twice separated by 5m.
Omar: Who's primary for PD for the window?
Priya: Omar you on PD primary, Nina infra backup, Carlos monitoring. I'll be the SRE lead. Please escalate to SRE lead if rollback required.
Priya: Preflight checklist (T-30):
- etcd/backup ok (<6h)
- no ongoing node upgrades
- alerting suppression configured
- run `kubectl get cs` and ensure components healthy
Omar: What are hard abort criteria?
Priya: Abort if any of:
- control-plane 5xx > 12% sustained >5m,
- leader election flaps >2 times in 10m,
- persistent admission controller failures impacting rollouts
If abort -> stop further restarts and restore previous apiserver binary.
deploy-bot: If rollback executed, create automated rollback ticket #roll-1853012345.
Carlos: Observability: Grafana apiserver dashboard https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/apiserver-eu-west, Logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/q?query=eu-west+apiserver
Nina: I'll post status updates every 10m in the incident channel and a final completion message.
Priya: Post-maint actions: snapshot metrics, run synthetic 100 calls to management API (p95 < 250ms target), and file a short blameless note if anything out-of-spec.
Omar: Acknowledged. I'll be at my station for the window.
Priya: Great 1. If anyone cannot make it, flag now so we can reschedule. Otherwise this is the official notice. :white_check_mark:
